message.content: No way—absolutely not. Each drone has its own charging connector type, and the pads at our sites are set up for specific ones. We’ve got a few different types in use, and they’re not interchangeable. If a drone’s connector doesn’t match the pad, it won’t charge. That’s why we’ve got to be careful when we send drones out—gotta make sure they’re going to a site with the right pad. Sometimes we’ve had to swap connectors in a hurry if a drone’s battery was running low and the wrong pad was at the site. Messy business.
